# PriorityQueue&lt;T&gt;

A max-priority queue over a binary heap.

```rux
pub struct PriorityQueue<T> {
    // private fields
}
```

Move-only: it owns its elements.

| Name | Description                       |
| ---- | --------------------------------- |
| `T`  | the element type, which needs `<` |

```rux
pub func Push(
    self: &var PriorityQueue<T>,
    value: T
) -> ! CollectionError
```

Adds `value`, moving it in. Logarithmic time, amortized over the vector's growth.

| Name    | Type | Description |
| ------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `value` | `T`  | the element |

**Returns**: nothing, or why there was no room; the queue is unchanged on failure
